scope: PySide6 6.12.0 QSvgRenderer loading valid local SVG controls
source_context: The separately built C++ QtSvg project instruments QtSvg 6.12.0 source. Its coverage and AFL map do not transfer to the PySide6 wheel's bundled QtSvg binary.
repeat_variant_map_check: not established for the pinned PySide6 native module
decision: Keep PySide6 staged as a verified Docker control until parser-scoped native feedback is demonstrated for this exact module.
shared_native_binary: The pinned PySide6 and PyQt6 linux/amd64 wheels contain byte-identical QtSvg 6.12.0 modules; prior PyQt6 QEMU/Frida valid-control failures are relevant but do not constitute a PySide6 feedback result.

linux_amd64_qemu_probe.result: Program timed off; one tuple reported; the target emitted no SVG result. The map is excluded from feedback claims.

resolution.approach: linux/arm64 container: the pinned wheels are installed unchanged except libQt6Svg.so.6, replaced by QtSvg 6.12.0 built from its pinned source tarball with LLVM source coverage (no QEMU or Frida). The prior binary-only probes below remain as history.
resolution.repeat_variant_map_check: afl-showmap: three control maps identical (1,030 tuples); controls/svg/red-blue-path.svg maps to 1,093 tuples, 8 control-only and 71 variant-only
resolution.shared_family: PyQt6 and PySide6 wheels ship the byte-identical QtSvg module and use the same source-built replacement; their 651 covered control regions are identical
